sentences.text: Mohd. Nurish vs State Of Uttarakhand on 14 August, 2024

Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 Anticipatory Bail Application No.765 of 2024
Mohd. Nurish ........Applicant
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand ........Respondent

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Present:-
Mr. Pradeep Chamyal, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Virendra Singh Rawat, Aga for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)

The applicant seeks anticipatory bail in Fir No.250 of 2024 dated 27.07.2024, under Section 376
Ipc and Section 64 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita 2023, Police Station Sitarganj, District Udham
Singh Nagar.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.

According to the FIR, the applicant had been sexually exploiting the informant for the last six months prior to lodging of the FIR under the pretext of marriage and thereafter he started ignoring her.
4.
Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the relations were consensual and both the parties are major.

5. State to file objections within four weeks.
6.

7. Having considered, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing personal bond and two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer ("AO"), subject to the following:-
(i) The applicant shall not approach in any manner, whatsoever, any of the witnesses in the case.

sentences.text: (ii) He shall cooperate with the investigation.
(iii) He shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
(iv) He shall deposit his passport with the AO.
The passport may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
If the applicant does not have passport, he shall give an undertaking to that effect to the AO.
(v) The applicant shall also give an undertaking on (i), (ii) & (iii) above.
(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 14.08.2024
